scope: 15 Commander, Planechase, Archenemy and collection product codes, distinguishing main boxed products from card-component subsets, with exact Scryfall code mappings
source_policy: The exact printed release product and content type is sourced to official Wizards pages. Scryfall set code, parent linkage and dates are independent catalog data; no claim Wizards printed each code or that a collection confers format legality.

records.source_section: Four Archenemy game packs each with a 60-card deck and separate 20-scheme deck
records.reason: Wizards directly establishes the 2010 release as four preconstructed game packs, not booster sets.

records.source_section: Commander Collection: Green Packaging and Contents

records.source_section: Commander Collection: Black Packaging and Contents
records.reason: A fixed eight-card Commander reprint collection with regular and premium-foil editions, not a randomized booster.

records.source_section: Commander's Arsenal contains 18 premium cards, ten oversized legends and accessories
records.reason: Wizards details a curated set of premium Commander reprints, oversized cards and accessories, not a booster pack or new Commander deck.

records.source_section: Four decks: Devour for Power, Built from Scratch, Wade into Battle, Breed Lethality

records.source_section: Commander Anthology Volume II, like its older sibling
